name: Stew Multi-Pull
description: Adds "Purchase x{{count}}" to the Mushroom Club's stew menu: {{count}} decal pulls in a row. The stew animation plays once instead of {{count}} times; every decal gets its own card, and each pull costs the normal price.
author: KSFA

settings.label: Pulls per purchase
settings.help: How many decals one "Purchase" in the new menu entry pulls. Each costs the normal price, so 25 costs 25 pulls' worth of Kill Coins.

patches.description: Purchase x{{count}} in the stew menu (BrgGame.upk)
